claim_boundary: This matched sensitivity asks whether the 800 K transport estimators change materially when the production thermostat is removed after identical NVT equilibration. It is one configuration and one temperature, so a pass supports robustness only within that scope; a failure requires thermostat-sensitive wording rather than deletion of either arm.
preregistration_note: Frozen while the first formal 700 K trajectory was incomplete and before any formal 800 K transport estimate existed.

matched_design.temperature_scope: The reference series must contain 800 K and the comparison must contain exactly 800 K.
matched_design.only_intended_dynamical_difference: production_ensemble: nvt versus nve; protocol identity, temperature-list scope, and preparation fields differ only to reuse the already-relaxed reference structure without relaxing it again

block_bootstrap.resampling: independent non-overlapping blocks within each arm, centered on the full-trajectory log effect

equivalence.required_for_each_estimator: The complete 95% bootstrap interval for NVE/NVT lies inside [2/3, 3/2].

nve_stability.hard_rule: A failed NVE stability or transport-resolution check blocks the comparison and triggers a separately fingerprinted extension or diagnostic run.

decision_rules.ensemble_robustness_pass: Both arms resolve all three estimators, the NVE stability checks pass, and every estimator meets the equivalence interval.
decision_rules.failed_equivalence_action: Retain both results and qualify the production-ensemble sensitivity; do not average the arms or claim thermostat-independent dynamics.
